english.note: Use this when “more” has an emphatic or “even more” sense, usually in an explicit comparison.
Use 仲 before a comparative or adjective when saying that something is even more so than before or than another thing.

examples.english: Today is even more chilly than yesterday.
examples.jyutping: gam1 jat6 zung6 dung3 gwo3 kam4 jat6

examples.english: It is already very cold today, and tomorrow will be even colder.
examples.traditional: 今日已經好凍，聽日仲凍。
examples.jyutping: gam1 jat6 ji5 ging1 hou2 dung3 ting1 jat6 zung6 dung3
